item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:20 HKT 07/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Tapah will edge closer to the western coast of Guangdong and intensify further today. It will be windy with heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the coastal areas today and tomorrow. Seas will be rough with swells. Under the influence of an active southerly airstream, there will still be showers and thunderstorms over the coast of southern China in the middle part of this week. An anticyclone aloft is expected to bring generally fine and very hot weather to Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 07/09 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 5 to 6, up to force 8 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. Sunny intervals in the morning. Showers will become frequent with squalls. Showers will be heavy later. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
